svg.text: DIP plug into the empty DX socket, pin 1 to the notch end. (Findings Q1: confirm U701 is socketed first.)

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: ② New pot hole: rear-panel-drill-template.pdf. Do not touch the tuning-pot harness (header D).

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: ③ Clock tap: mini-grabber on R791 (Q709-collector side). 10 kΩ + Schmitt input on the TimeShift side.

svg.text: ④ Board (84 × 63 mm) in ZONE A on 4 self-adhesive snap-lock supports (12.7 mm), J1 towards U701,

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: ribbon ≤ 15 cm. Check lid clearance first (findings Q3: ≥ 32 mm incl. the Nano) and any 1760B sync

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: board or Electrongate MIDI board in the area. ZONE B needs a 20–25 cm ribbon: use it only after the

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: GEN0* scope check (findings Q4). Power comes through the ribbon (U701 pins 16/8): no extra wires;

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: never use the +5M battery rail. Flash the Nano OUT of the board, or only with the DX switched on.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: JP1 (PPQN): no shunt = 96 (plain DX); shunt on JP1 1-2 = 48 (D10); shunt on JP1 3-4 = 24 (D11).
